questions.question: If ‘A # B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’ and ‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’, then which of the following expressions means ‘C is the mother of F’?
questions.solution:
Let us first decode the given symbols and then draw a family tree:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a4b2137caec7bbc2f2a06cea27da54fa0e8e1c3c095e88e63704465aa8abc32.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fd6cab610f720d74911a910004a74b250f0cafb23fad64b63aa6509fbfac474.png] 

**From option 1:-**

**C @ H # M # F**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aac5d867373b438b4e974933eabd961c48d6aeb983eeff44a63f0577869af255.png] 

**C is the mother of F is correct.**

From option 2:-

H @ C # M # F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3090ba4f00e4c6c627c701fe084ddb4761feee6b8be3f111629543f427806ef7.png] 

C is the sister of F, not C is the mother of F. So, it is wrong.

From option 3:-

C @ H # M @ F

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eba142f8486a3660becb8736bc514ef6bb030a2fe850e6bcbe17e2a36fddcabc.png] 

C is the grandmother of F, not C is the mother of F. So, it is wrong.

From option 4:-

F @ H # M # C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/14362d1505cf531ff401f73ebdddaae60c3823db01f6ec9cce0a751e5a6edc4b.png] 

C is either son or daughter of F, not C is the mother of F. So, it is wrong.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘NOSTALGIA’ is coded as ‘81’. How will ‘FRICTION’ be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:-

**The square of total number of letter of word = Number code**

'NOSTALGIA' = 9² = 81. 

Similarly,

The square of total number of letter of word 'FRICTION' = 82 = 64.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K _ C T Q _ O C _ _ K O _ T _ K O _ T T

options.text: O, K, T, R, C, S, C
O, K, U, R, C, S, C
P, K, T, R, C, S, C
O, K, T, R, C, T, C

questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**From option 1:-**

K **O** C T Q / **K** O C **T R** / K O **C** T **S /** K O **C** T T → follows a pattern.

**Here K O C T remains the same but the last letter increased by 1 in each group.**

From option 2:-

K O C T Q / K O C U R / K O C T S / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

From option 3:-

K P C T Q / K O C T R / K O C T S / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

From option 4:-

K O C T Q / K O C T R / K O C T T / K O C T T → don't follow a pattern.

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

Given that:-

**= 16 × 16 **

questions.solution:

Power four of second number and add 2 in that number then we get first number. 

3⁴ + 2 = 81 + 2 = 83

And,

44 + 2 = 256 + 2 = 258

Similarly,

5⁴ + 2 = 625 + 2 = 627

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
